description: This is a Java test class for testing the Customer REST controller in the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It includes methods to test CRUD operations and creating customer options and values via REST API endpoints.

classes.name: CustomerRESTControllerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the Customer REST API endpoints, including methods to add, get, and delete customer data, as well as customer options and values.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers with JSON content type and Basic Authentication.

methods.name: postCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Tests creating a new customer option value via REST API.

methods.name: postCustomerOption
methods.description: Tests creating a new customer option via REST API.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches the list of customers via REST API and prints the count.

methods.name: postCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer via REST API and stores the assigned customer ID.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID via REST API.
